properties.name: A statement's kind can say it is an objection, a reply, an unstated premise or a rule of method, as a line of reasoning needs
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" (cogito trial)
properties.statement:
statement_kind (or an equivalent field) covers the roles a line of reasoning gives its statements: objection, reply, unstated (suppressed) premise, and rule of method. Each reads accordingly. A supposition or hypothesis is already in phase 3 (req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems, item 3).
Observed in the cogito trial (2026-10-18): none fitted, so the designer used `proposition` or `axiom` and put the role in the text.
